facts.evidence: **Revenues** rose **24% YoY** to **$119.8 billion** (23% in constant currency), marking the **12th consecutive quarter of double-digit growth**.
**Google Cloud revenues** surged **82% YoY** to **$24.8 billion**, led by AI infrastructure and enterprise solutions.
**Google Services revenues** increased **15% YoY** to **$94.5 billion**
**Operating income** grew **30% YoY** to **$40.8 billion**, with an **operating margin expansion** of **2 percentage points to 34%**.
primarily due to a **$98.0 billion net gain on equity securities** ... The **$98.0 billion net gain** in Q2 2026 (vs. **$2.7 billion in Q2 2025**)
**Equity capital raise** of **$49.6 billion** in June 2026, with proceeds allocated to **AI infrastructure and global compute scaling**.

claims.claim: Revenues rose 24% year over year to $119.8 billion in Q2 2026.
Revenue growth was 23% in constant currency.
The quarter marked Alphabet's 12th consecutive quarter of double-digit revenue growth.
Google Services revenues increased 15% year over year to $94.5 billion.
Google Search & other grew 17%.
Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices grew 15%.
YouTube ads grew 13%.
Google Cloud revenues rose 82% year over year to $24.8 billion.
Google Cloud growth was led by AI infrastructure and enterprise solutions.
Operating income grew 30% year over year to $40.8 billion.
claims.note: 30% growth is stated in the release; $40,770M on the income statement rounds to $40.8B.

claims.claim: Operating margin expanded by 2 percentage points to 34%.
Net income available to common stockholders increased 298% year over year to $112.1 billion.
EPS rose 294% to $9.11.
The increase in net income and EPS was primarily due to a $98.0 billion net gain on equity securities.
claims.note: Conflates two line items. $98.0B ($97,983M) is other income (expense), net, which the release says was 'primarily the result of' net unrealized equity gains; the gain on equity securities itself was $99.0B ($99,031M). The release quantifies the equity-gain effect as +$77.1B to net income and +$6.26 to diluted EPS, neither of which the brief cites.

claims.claim: Google Services accounted for $94.5 billion in revenue.
Search & other (17% growth) and YouTube ads (13% growth) were key contributors to Google Services.
Gemini Enterprise adoption reached 90% of Fortune 100 companies.
claims.note: The release says 'nearly 90% of the Fortune 100 using it.' Dropping 'nearly' asserts a threshold the release explicitly says has not yet been reached.

claims.claim: Gemini models process 22 billion API tokens per minute.
The Gemini App has 950 million monthly active users.
Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber is a new security solution.
YouTube attracted 1.7 billion unique viewers for FIFA World Cup 2026 content.
claims.note: Release says 'over 1.7 billion unique viewers watching World Cup-related videos'; the brief's figure is a conservative restatement.

claims.claim: AI-driven features and security solutions contributed to growth in enterprise and consumer segments.
claims.note: Fair paraphrase of the CEO quote: AI features driving Search query growth and strong demand for security solutions.

claims.claim: No formal guidance was provided in the release.
CEO Sundar Pichai emphasized AI investments as a key driver.
Enterprise AI solutions and infrastructure scaling are focal points.
The release contains no mention of revenue or earnings expectations for future periods.
Cash and cash equivalents increased to $55.9 billion from $30.7 billion at year-end 2025.
Alphabet completed an equity capital raise of $49.6 billion in June 2026.
claims.note: Release specifies $49.6B of aggregate net proceeds from Class A and Class C stock plus mandatory convertible preferred stock.

claims.claim: Proceeds of the equity raise are allocated to AI infrastructure and global compute scaling.
claims.note: Release states proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including capital expenditures to scale AI infrastructure and global compute; the brief's narrower framing is directionally consistent.

claims.claim: Alphabet issued senior unsecured notes for $20.3 billion in Q2 2026 for general corporate purposes.
The $98.0 billion net gain in Q2 2026 compares with $2.7 billion in Q2 2025.
claims.note: Both figures match other income (expense), net ($97,983M vs $2,662M). Note the brief files this under 'Equity securities volatility'; the equity-securities line was $99,031M vs $1,286M.

claims.claim: The gain significantly impacted net income.
Future fluctuations in equity securities could materially affect earnings.
claims.note: Release states fluctuations could significantly contribute to the volatility of OI&E in future periods.

claims.claim: Alphabet-level activities, including shared AI research costs, are not allocated to segments.
